LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ThreatPointsPeak: Highest storyteller threat points recorded in save history (ThreatPoints at 0.5-day intervals, restored from internal 1/10 scale).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ThreatPointsLatest: Actual storyteller threat points at the final point of the save's ThreatPoints history. Opens the 0.5-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_ThreatPointsMean: Mean of valid storyteller threat points across the save's ThreatPoints history. Opens the 0.5-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationLatest: Storyteller adaptation days at the final point of the save's Adaptation history (may be negative after colonist downs or deaths). Opens the 1-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationMean: Mean storyteller adaptation days across valid 1-day points in the save's Adaptation history. Opens the 1-day recorder curve in colony history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationPeak: Highest storyteller adaptation days recorded in the save's Adaptation history.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AdaptationMin: Lowest storyteller adaptation days recorded in the save's Adaptation history (including negative values after losses).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_XenotypePeak: The highest count observed in a successful save, calculated separately for each Biotech xenotype.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BirthsBySpecies: Humanlike children born alive on the player's side, grouped by species at birth.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnomalyDiscoveredEntities: Highest number of discovered entity types recorded in the Entity Codex at a successful save (including conservative 1.7 historical save salvage).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnomalyMonolithHighestLev: Highest void monolith awakening level reached (not applicable in playstyles without a monolith unless progressed).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnomalyHeldEntitiesPeak: Highest number of living entities held on player-owned holding platforms at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnomalyPsychicRitualsByDe: Completed player-initiated psychic rituals grouped by ritual type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnomalyEntityEscapes: Confirmed escapes of living entities from player-owned holding platforms.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnomalyEntitiesContained: Distinct living entities newly secured onto player-owned holding platforms during recorded play (excluding platform transfers and pre-existing captives).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnomalyPitGatesCollapsed: Pit gates cleared and collapsed after defeating the Undercave Dreadmeld.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechBossgroupsSummoned: Total mechanitor bossgroup waves summoned by a successful save, broken down by bossgroup type (including conservative 1.7 historical save salvage).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechBossesDefeated: Distinct mechanitor boss types recorded as defeated in the colony, broken down by boss type (including conservative 1.7 historical save salvage).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseySubstructurePeak: Highest count of valid connected gravship substructure cells observed on a landed player gravship at save (not applicable while mid-flight).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyThrustersPeak: Highest count of connected thrusters observed on a landed player gravship at save (not applicable while mid-flight).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyUniqueWeaponsPeak: Highest count of unique weapons held on player home maps or carried by living player pawns at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyUniqueWeaponsByTra: Traits carried on player-owned unique weapons at the representative save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyChemfuelConsumed: Cumulative chemfuel deducted from player gravship fuel tanks during launches.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyOrbitArrivals: Confirmed player arrivals in the Orbit planet layer via gravship landing or transport pods and shuttles.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_OdysseyVisitedLandmarks: Distinct world landmark tiles visited by player maps, gravships, pods, or caravans, grouped by landmark type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechGrowthVatCompletio: Completed living child growth cycles and living embryo births in player growth vats. A child's growth is complete when the vat ejects the child at age 18; a child ejected earlier with "Cancel vatgrowth" is not counted.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechGeneExtractions: Completed gene extractions on player gene extractors that produced a genepack.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechXenogermsAssembled: Completed xenogerm recombinations on player gene assemblers.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechGenesImplanted: Completed xenogerm item implantations and direct reimplantations involving colony pawns.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_BiotechBossFirstDefeatedT: In-game day on which each mechanitor boss type was first defeated while recorded.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WorldTemperature: Planet overall temperature setting recorded for the colony's world.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WorldRainfall: Planet overall rainfall setting recorded for the colony's world.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_WorldPollution: Planet surface pollution percentage recorded for the colony's world.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_InitialMapSize: Total cell count of the initial colony map, with dimensions shown in the breakdown.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_MechSpeciesPeak: Highest count of living player-faction mechanoids observed at a successful save, calculated separately per mechanoid type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyFluidReforms: Completed reforms of the player's fluid ideoligion by save (not applicable for fixed ideoligions; includes conservative 1.7 save salvage).
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyGauranlenPeak: Highest count of Gauranlen trees on player home maps actively connected to living player pawns at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyRelicsPeak: Highest count of primary-ideoligion relics held in player possession at a successful save.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyPrisonersEnslaved: Colony prisoners newly enslaved into the player's colony during recorded play.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_IdeologyBiosculpterComple: Completed cycles on player biosculpter pods for colony pawns, grouped by cycle type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPermitUsesByDef: Confirmed royal title permit activations by colony pawns, grouped by permit type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyPsycastsByDef: Confirmed vanilla psycast activations by colony pawns, grouped by psycast ability.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RoyaltyAnimaLinks: Completed psylink linking rituals that granted a psylink level to a colony pawn.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsRetreatedByFaction: Hostile raids that retreated during recorded play, grouped by attacking faction type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_RaidsWipedByFaction: Hostile raids completely wiped out during recorded play, grouped by attacking faction type.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsTamedBySpecies: Wild animals tamed into the player faction, grouped by animal species.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalBirthsBySpecies: Animals born or hatched into the player faction, grouped by animal species.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsSlaughteredBySpeci: Player-faction animals slaughtered by execution, grouped by animal species.
LanguageData.RWS_MetricDesc_AnimalsHuntedBySpecies: Wild animals killed via hunting by player pawns, grouped by animal species.
LanguageData.RWS_Chronicle_TipAuxiliaryTale: Auxiliary narrative record preserved in the save's permanent Tale Manager; never added to numeric event totals.
